mapper.sql: s.shift_id, s.station_id, s.user_id, s.staff_name, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.active_flag, s.ended_by, s.end_reason, s.proxy_count, s.redeem_count, s.cng_volume, s.lng_volume, s.pay_amount, st.station_name
mapper.select: select shift_id, station_id, user_id, staff_name, started_at, ended_at, active_flag, ended_by, end_reason, proxy_count, redeem_count, cng_volume, lng_volume, pay_amount from gas_shift where shift_id = #{shiftId} for update
select from gas_shift s left join gas_station st on s.station_id = st.station_id where s.station_id = #{stationId} and s.active_flag = 1 limit 1

select shift_id, station_id, user_id, staff_name, started_at, ended_at, active_flag, ended_by, end_reason, proxy_count, redeem_count, cng_volume, lng_volume, pay_amount from gas_shift where station_id = #{stationId} and active_flag = 1 limit 1 for update
select from gas_shift s left join gas_station st on s.station_id = st.station_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.active_flag = 1 limit 1

select from gas_shift s left join gas_station st on s.station_id = st.station_id
and s.station_id = #{stationId} and s.user_id = #{userId} and s.active_flag = 1 and s.active_flag is null and s.staff_name like concat('%', #{staffName}, '%')
order by s.shift_id desc

select proxy.proxy_count, done.redeem_count, done.cng_volume, done.lng_volume, done.pay_amount from (select count(1) as proxy_count from gas_order where created_shift_id = #{shiftId}) proxy join ( select count(1) as redeem_count, coalesce(sum(case when gas_type = 'CNG' then actual_volume else 0 end), 0) as cng_volume, coalesce(sum(case when gas_type = 'LNG' then actual_volume else 0 end), 0) as lng_volume, coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) as pay_amount from gas_order where completed_shift_id = #{shiftId} and status = 'COMPLETED' ) done on 1 = 1
mapper.insert: insert into gas_shift (station_id, user_id, staff_name, started_at, active_flag) values (#{stationId}, #{userId}, #{staffName}, sysdate(), 1)
mapper.update: update gas_shift set ended_at = sysdate(), active_flag = null, ended_by = #{endedBy}, end_reason = #{endReason}, proxy_count = #{proxyCount}, redeem_count = #{redeemCount}, cng_volume = #{cngVolume}, lng_volume = #{lngVolume}, pay_amount = #{payAmount} where shift_id = #{shiftId} and active_flag = 1
